summary: Selecting “Adjust inventory by splitting this stack” queues the internal altadjust row and its inventory letter. C cmd.c:rhack executes the queued row’s function pointer, but JS rhack has no queued adjust_split branch and falls through to its generic unsupported-command boundary before invent.c:adjust_split runs. The direct extended-command switch and existing adjust_split/splitobj owners are already present; the missing behavior is the queued function-pointer dispatch and its ECMD result handling.

source.branch: When a non-gold object stack has quantity greater than one, iactions.c:itemactions offers IA_ADJUST_STACK on I. Selecting it queues the altadjust extcmd row and the object inventory letter. The row has a null ef_txt and ef_funct=adjust_split, so C cmd.c:rhack must dispatch that queued function pointer before reading another user key. JS currently normalizes the queued row to adjust_split, but the main rhack path has no corresponding queued-function branch.
callers: allmain.c:moveloop_core enters cmd.c:rhack(0) for normal hero input and queued-command dispatch.

invent.c:ddoinv -> invent.c:dispinv_with_action -> iactions.c:itemactions -> iactions.c:itemactions_pushkeys(IA_ADJUST_STACK) queues adjust_split and the selected inventory letter; this is the recorded entry path.
invent.c:doI -> query_objlist -> iactions.c:itemactions can reach the same IA_ADJUST_STACK menu and queues the same function pointer.
dependencies: The existing js/invent.js:adjust_split implementation remains the canonical callee; it consumes the result of mkobj.c:splitobj and then calls doorganize_core.
The existing js/obj.js:splitobj implementation and its next_ident, inventory insertion, and split-context behavior are already source-pinned; the mismatch occurs before this code runs.
The existing js/iactions.js:itemactions_pushkeys branch queues extcmdRow(altadjust) followed by the inventory letter; the missing dispatch belongs in js/cmd.js:rhack.

evidence: The saved combined queue SHA-256 is 2e8b3e804b97958332bd671398c4be5bc87ed1064c8a2f90de33c0b1adf2cd58. Its v47 entry identifies 214 remaining screens of 247, with 33/247 screens, 4619/5176 RNG values, and 33/247 cursors matched at the baseline evaluation. The original stop is zero-based recording step 33 (manifest boundary 34), input I.

The admitted recording challenges/cases/v47/v47-timed-egg-stack-split-attempt6.session.json shows C opening the item-actions menu at step 32 with “Adjust inventory by splitting this stack” on I. At step 33 C prints “Split 1 to what [o-zA-Z] (? see used letters)?” and records rnd(2)=2 at mkobj.c:next_ident; step 34 selects z and prints “Splitting: z - an egg.” The recipe itself states the later 180-turn wait is only a retained egg-hatch target probe.

Upstream iactions.c:itemactions() offers IA_ADJUST_STACK only for quan>1 and non-COIN_CLASS at lines 467-469. itemactions_pushkeys() lines 195-198 queues adjust_split, then otmp->invlet. invent.c:dispinv_with_action() reaches itemactions after the selected inventory letter; invent.c:ddoinv() is the recorded caller.

Upstream cmd.c:rhack() lines 3639-3648 pops CMDQ_EXTCMD and jumps to do_cmdq_extcmd; lines 3681-3686 uses the queued extcmd table row; lines 3717-3720 assigns tlist->ef_funct and lines 3753-3755 call (*func)(). cmd.c:2062 defines altadjust with a null key/text and adjust_split as ef_funct.

The current JS replay of the admitted recording through js/jsmain.js:runSegment stops at the same point with UnsupportedHeroCommandBoundaryError, key 0; the inventory remains at slot n with quan=2 and context.ident remains 63. js/iactions.js:299 queues extcmdRow(altadjust) and the selected invlet; js/extcmdlist_data.js:209 maps altadjust to adjust_split. In js/cmd.js:5424 rhack falls back from ef_txt to ef_funct, and it has a doorganize queued-function arm at lines 5662-5671 but no adjust_split arm before its generic fallback at lines 6520-6534.

The direct JS extended-command switch already has case adjust_split at js/cmd.js:5102, and js/invent.js:adjust_split plus js/obj.js:splitobj are present. Existing scripts/cmd.test.mjs:3793 covers IA_ADJUST_OBJ queue dispatch, but no focused test exercises IA_ADJUST_STACK through the real inventory-menu, queue, adjust_split, and destination-letter sequence. The implementation scope is therefore a bounded cmd.c:rhack divergence fix with production-path coverage, not a new adjust_split or splitobj port.
